```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

options(pillar.sigfig = 5)
options(scipen = 999)
```
## Loading the data
```{r}
#| label: import-data
#| include: false

train <- read.csv(
  file = "train.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "latin1"
)
test <- read.csv(
  file = "test.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "latin1"
)
submit_example <- read.csv(
  file = "sample_submission.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "latin1"
)
```

## Counting the missing values in my 5 predictors
```{r}
count_missings <- function(x) sum(is.na(x))
train |>
  summarise(across(
    c(OverallQual, GrLivArea, GarageCars, TotalBsmtSF, YearBuilt),
    count_missings
  ))
```

```{r}
train <- train |>
  mutate(OverallQual = factor(OverallQual))
```

## Training and Validation Split
```{r}
set.seed(124)

index <- sample(
  x = 1:nrow(train),
  size = floor(nrow(train) * 0.7),
  replace = FALSE
)

train_fold <- train[index, ]
validation_fold <- train[-index, ]
```

## Fit and Evaluate the LM
```{r}
model <- lm(
  SalePrice ~ OverallQual + GrLivArea + GarageCars + TotalBsmtSF + YearBuilt,
  data = train_fold
)

summary(model) # R2 = .77
```

## Calculate RMSE and R2
```{r}
rmse <- function(observed, predicted) sqrt(mean((predicted - observed)^2))

R2 <- function(observed, predicted) {
  TSS <- sum((observed - mean(observed))^2)
  RSS <- sum((predicted - observed)^2)
  1 - RSS / TSS
}
```

## Compare Training and Validation Performance
```{r}
train_predictions <- predict(model, newdata = train_fold)

validation_predictions <- predict(
  model,
  newdata = validation_fold
)

performance <- tibble(
  Dataset = c("Training", "Validation"),
  RMSE = c(
    rmse(train_fold$SalePrice, train_predictions),
    rmse(validation_fold$SalePrice, validation_predictions)
  ),
  R2 = c(
    R2(train_fold$SalePrice, train_predictions),
    R2(validation_fold$SalePrice, validation_predictions)
  )
)

# Training and estimated out-of-sample performance
performance
```

## Five-Fold Cross-Validation
```{r}
set.seed(124)

k <- 5

folds <- sample(
  rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(train_fold))
)

cv_results <- tibble(
  Fold = integer(),
  RMSE = double(),
  R2 = double()
)

for (i in 1:k) {
  cv_train <- train_fold[folds != i, ]
  cv_test <- train_fold[folds == i, ]

  cv_model <- lm(
    SalePrice ~ OverallQual + GrLivArea + GarageCars + TotalBsmtSF + YearBuilt,
    data = cv_train
  )

  cv_predictions <- predict(
    cv_model,
    newdata = cv_test
  )

  cv_results <- bind_rows(
    cv_results,
    tibble(
      Fold = i,
      RMSE = rmse(cv_test$SalePrice, cv_predictions),
      R2 = R2(cv_test$SalePrice, cv_predictions)
    )
  )
}

cv_results
```

## Average Cross-Validation Performance
```{r}
cv_results |>
  summarise(
    Mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    Mean_R2 = mean(R2)
  )
```

## Cross-Validation Visualization
```{r}
cv_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Fold), y = R2)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.75,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "R-squared Across Cross-Validation Folds",
    x = "Fold",
    y = "R-squared"
  )
```
## Submit to Kaggle
```{r}
submission_model <- lm(
  SalePrice ~ OverallQual + GrLivArea + GarageCars + TotalBsmtSF + YearBuilt,
  data = train
)
```

```{r}
test <- test |>
  mutate(
    OverallQual = factor(
      OverallQual,
      levels = levels(train$OverallQual)
    ),
    GarageCars = replace_na(GarageCars, 0),
    TotalBsmtSF = replace_na(TotalBsmtSF, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
test |>
  select(OverallQual, GrLivArea, GarageCars, TotalBsmtSF, YearBuilt) |>
  summarise_all(count_missings)
```

```{r}
submission_predictions <- predict(submission_model, newdata = test)

head(submission_predictions)
```

```{r}
#need to look like this so get Id and SalePrice
head(submit_example)

submission <- test |>
  select(Id) |>
  mutate(SalePrice = submission_predictions)

head(submission)

# write to csv
write.csv(submission, "kaggle_submission.csv", row.names = F)
```
